Description: Condensed local baseline: all phase/process samples and operation aggregates retained; bounded operation histories, process IDs and zero-utilization GPU engine entries omitted. Raw reports remain in the ignored Tools/PerformanceHarness/results directory. API sub-call and batch failures may count the same underlying failure; not an incident count.

Runs.Limits: Synthetic GDI/timer workload; DWM includes unrelated desktop activity. CPU is percent of one core. GPU values are separate engine counters, not an overall sum. Restore timing is API acknowledgement, not first painted frame.
